title: API rate limit choices
decision: 120 requests a minute with a burst of 60 per user and 600 a minute with a burst of 200 per shop; per user rather than per session; counters held in the one application process; the shop's limit applies only to callers known as its members and only answers a member can get count against it; requests that are not signed in, the webhook and the provider endpoints are left to the proxy
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 39
rationale: The specification asks for limits per session, user and shop and gives no numbers; a busy shop must not answer a stranger differently from an idle one
